rows.en: It didn't seem that way, though...
Hm!? Something's lying over there, isn't it?
Your destination has been marked on the MAP.
W's "Xtreme Memory" should be on this floor too.
Taboo Dopant!! You don't have to tell me! I'll take you down!
Fufufu...!! That's it, go on wasting your time.
Fufufu...!! That's it, go on wasting your time.
Fufufu...!! That's it, go on wasting your time.
Fufufu...!! That's it, go on wasting your time.
Yeah! You said it!! Cyclone Joker Xtreme it is!
We'll be fine. Leave it to us!
I don't know... But for now, all we can do is keep going.
Ikadevil's Shocker Greeed? It's close...
Got it. There's just one Gaia Gate left. Move fast!
With this, our next plan will be set in motion... Fu fu fu fu...
You will focus mainly on searching for the lost "power"... in other words, equipment items.
So it seems... Let's hurry.
Here too!? It's as if they can read our every move!!
Let's leave this to Cherudim and the others.
Whoa, here they come again!! Everyone! I'm counting on you!
Cherudim is fighting here. Let's leave this to him and find another way.
Heavyarms is fighting here. Let's leave this to him and find another way.
Kamen Rider Birth is fighting here. Let's leave this to him and find another way.
She was probably talking to the boss here, Reborns Gundam.
All right, let's catch up with Cherudim and the others!
When they entered the room, Cherudim and the others, who had arrived first, were bustling about.
The particle cannon isn't on this side.
Most likely...
What the hell is going on outside!?
That helps!
If at all possible, I want to avoid pointless fighting. Understood!!
"What are you doing!! Well!? You still haven't found it!?"
So you think so too. Let's go and see.
That entrance past the Ride Dungeon has me curious.
Your destination has been marked on the MAP.
I've enhanced it thoroughly myself, after all. I'm sure it will prove useful.
If you're going, then hurry it up.
Your destination has been marked on the MAP.
How's Seravee doing? We're going to check on the Terminal Unit.
...Fine, whatever. We're steering clear of pointless fights.
Yeah. Better to steer clear of pointless fights.
Right, that's dealt with. Let's hurry to the high-energy reading.
Hm...? What is that...!!
Don't tell me...
Now I can wait for that to be completed without a care.
Your destination has been marked on the MAP.
Ready? Let's go. The Gundam Team is just ahead.
Your destination has been marked on the MAP.
All right! Let's just push on ahead.
GN particles, maximum dispersal!!
Your destination has been marked on the MAP.
"Huge Space" has been added to the MAP.
A Super Soldier... a being the Super Soldier Institute created for the sake of war...
That's far enough!!
Looks like the enemy has shored up its defenses, but the Colony Laser's base is right before us!!
Leave this to us, and hurry after Reborns and the others!!
"Veda" has been marked on the MAP.
From out of nowhere, a "voice" could be heard. It was as if it echoed directly inside their minds...
How should I know... Figure it out yourself... See ya...
...Yeah, all right. The base took heavy damage too. Let's head back for now and work out a plan.
It's a kind of telepathy that Innovators give off.
"Libra Cannon Reactor Core" has been marked on the MAP.
Go, now! While you have the chance!!
Hurry up and go after Reborns and the rest!!
Get close and they'll come at us, no doubt. Watch yourselves.
Yes, though only roughly. Keep going the way you are.
...To the north, huh?
Right. There's no need to force a fight. Let's look for another way.
Other than the path sealed off by the tentacles... all that's left is the side passage.
Right. There's no need to force a fight.
Your destination has been marked on the MAP.
Geronimon must be Belial's doing too. Don't let your guard down as you go.
Hey, we're heading back!!
Your destination has been marked on the MAP.
Let's go.
The door's open!!
I see... Whatever. We'll take down the remaining Zetton and Tyrant.
No helping it. Guess we move on...

notes.note: Last party-leader variant (k=14 in Pt_Chara_Check order; script names Taro, CHARA_NAME 13). Identical JP to 0.98-0.102, so identical EN.
Ankh (script: CHARA_NAME 36 before final MessWinSet) notices the key ring lying there; next table 0569 is the key ring pickup.
Last leader variant = Wing Zero (CHARA_NAME 9); copied the identical-JP English of 0.3-0.15.
Last leader variant = Wing Zero; used the majority English of identical rows 0.11-0.16.
Taboo Dopant's taunt in the Zone Dopant warp rooms (0572-0575 are four copies of the same scene); 'Fufufu...!!' matches her 0.2 laugh.

Not played by the decompiled final MessWinSet; fits as Shotaro's reply to Philip's 0.26 'let's put the Xtreme Memory to use right away!'. 'Cyclone Joker Xtreme' = official form name (not in glossary).
Last leader variant = 00 (CHARA_NAME 10); identical JP to 0.219-0.230.
Last leader variant = God Gundam (CHARA_NAME 8); identical JP to 0.10-0.15.
Last leader variant = God Gundam; identical JP to 0.45, so reused its English ('Move fast!').
Terror Dopant, unreached alt line after the Veda reveal; laugh styled like his 0576.74 'Fu fu fu...'.
No speaker name in the script (CharaNameOut before it); written as a neutral party line.
0606-0608: nameless field prompts; 'him' per glossary gender (all m).
'She' = Gaddess (g=f), who was speaking in 0.57-0.62; Ankh asked who she was talking to.
Narration; plays on a separate visit than the 0.47 departure line.
No speaker recovered; the event's other lines are Seravee's (CHARA_NAME 73), so it reads as his.
Slice says Cherudim, but the script sets CHARA_NAME 73 (Seravee) for the final MessWinSet; Cherudim's 0.174 comm line offers the data, and this is the thanks. English works for either.
Comm voice in Japanese corner brackets, rendered in double quotes like 0618's comm lines.
Ankh closes the 'wait, Seravee isn't back' exchange; who is 'going' is left open as in the source.
Last leader variant = Rider 1; identical JP to 0.3-0.15.
Last leader variant = Rider 1; identical JP.
'That' (are) = an unnamed project of Ribbons's; kept vague as in the source.
No speaker recovered; follows the leader-variant block, most likely Ankh (team leader in this arc).
Matches 0.122's opening ('All right! Let's just push on ahead.').
Huge space = the area name used in 0.3 / 0653; capitalised as a MAP label.
Super Soldier Institute (glossary has only Super Soldier). 00 reflecting on the defeated Ahead Smultron pilot.
Last leader variant = Rider 1 (CHARA_NAME 1).
No speaker recovered; after declining to fight the Gundam Head. Likely Ankh.
No speaker recovered; likely Ankh or Seravee's voice.
No speaker recovered; same choice as 0710.
Remaining Zetton and Tyrant: the kaiju still to be defeated in this area.

report: All rows translated. Last-variant rows matched to the speaker named by the final CharaNameIn and reuse identical-JP English. 0618 speaker is Seravee per script (slice says Cherudim). Not in glossary: Cyclone Joker Xtreme, Super Soldier Institute.
